description: Source code implementing bit operations and related commands for Redis, including bit counting, bit position, bitwise operations, and bitfield manipulations.

methods.name: redisPopcount
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in a binary array.

methods.name: redisBitpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first bit set to 1 or 0 in a bitmap.

methods.name: setUnsignedBitfield
methods.description: Sets an unsigned integer value at an arbitrary bit offset within a bitmap.

methods.name: setSignedBitfield
methods.description: Sets a signed integer value at an arbitrary bit offset within a bitmap.

methods.name: getUnsignedBitfield
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned integer value from an arbitrary bit offset within a bitmap.

methods.name: getSignedBitfield
methods.description: Retrieves a signed integer value from an arbitrary bit offset within a bitmap.

methods.name: checkUnsignedBitfieldOverflow
methods.description: Checks for overflow or underflow when storing an unsigned value with a specified bit width.

methods.name: checkSignedBitfieldOverflow
methods.description: Checks for overflow or underflow when storing a signed value with a specified bit width.

methods.name: bitfieldGeneric
methods.description: Implements the core logic for the BITFIELD command and its read-only variant.

methods.name: setbitCommand
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in a string key.

methods.name: getbitCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific bit in a string key.

methods.name: bitopCommand
methods.description: Performs bitwise operations (AND, OR, XOR, NOT) on string keys.

methods.name: bitcountCommand
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in a string key, optionally within a range.

methods.name: bitposCommand
methods.description: Finds the position of the first bit set to 1 or 0 in a string key, optionally within a range.
